mapper.insert: INSERT INTO v5ai_app_usage (agent_key, usage_date, model_calls, tokens, updated_at) VALUES (#{agentKey}, #{usageDate}, 1, #{tokens}, now()) ON CONFLICT (agent_key, usage_date) DO UPDATE SET model_calls = v5ai_app_usage.model_calls + 1, tokens = v5ai_app_usage.tokens + EXCLUDED.tokens, updated_at = now()
